approved_meaning: Missing chart-only numeric display values are rendered as zero and are not portfolio returns or model inputs.
Missing source-method row counts are display-only count buckets and are not financial observations.
Missing market-cap audit row counts are display-only count buckets and are not market-cap estimates.
Missing supported-row counts are display-only audit counts and are not fabricated market-cap evidence.
A ticker absent from a supplied weight vector is an explicit zero position; selected-return availability is checked separately and strictly.
A strategy that does not hold an asset has a structural zero in the exported full weight matrix.
Absent supplied holdings are structural zero positions after nonzero out-of-universe and non-finite weights have been rejected.
Assets absent from a strategy weight vector contribute zero to a display-only asset-class allocation sum.
A ticker absent from the fitted training weight vector is an explicit zero position in validation-return aggregation; validation returns remain observed and are not zero-filled.
An absent crypto sleeve is an explicit zero exposure for the portfolio constraint audit.
An absent crypto sleeve is an explicit zero exposure for the reported constraint evidence.
Assets absent from the supplied portfolio are structural zero positions; every nonzero supplied ticker and selected return is validated before aggregation.
A missing observation count is treated as zero only for the history-eligibility rejection gate; no return or risk observation is imputed.
A selected issuer absent from a model builder output is an explicit zero candidate weight before the common group-constrained projection; return observations remain complete-case validated.
Assets outside a model weight vector are structural zero positions used only for full-universe constraint reconciliation.
Assets outside a model weight vector are structural zero positions; selected-return coverage remains governed by portfolio_return_series.
Assets not held by the selected model are structural zero positions in the scenario-aligned weight vector.
A ticker observed in one scenario has zero observed cross-scenario weight dispersion; the output remains diagnostic rather than promotion evidence.
A ticker absent from the current scenario portfolio is an explicit zero position in union-index turnover alignment.
A ticker absent from the base portfolio is an explicit zero position in union-index turnover alignment.
A non-finite aggregate diagnostic score receives the neutral score zero after component-level controls; history eligibility remains a separate hard gate.
A missing diagnostic feature z-score receives a neutral zero only where the separate history-eligibility gate prevents promotion as a standard composite score.
A missing diagnostic feature robust z-score receives a neutral zero only where the separate history-eligibility gate prevents standard selection.
Test assets not held by the model are structural zero positions; nonzero model tickers missing from returns are rejected by portfolio_return_series.
An asset absent from the current target portfolio is an explicit zero holding in union-index gross L1 turnover alignment.
An asset absent from the prior drifted portfolio is an explicit zero holding in union-index gross L1 turnover alignment.
Independent turnover replay aligns an absent current holding to structural zero across the union of portfolio names; selected returns are separately required to be complete.
Independent turnover replay aligns an absent prior holding to structural zero across the union of portfolio names; selected returns are separately required to be complete.
Independent turnover replay aligns an absent current holding to structural zero across the union of portfolio names.
Independent turnover replay aligns an absent prior holding to structural zero across the union of portfolio names.
Independent random-benchmark replay aligns an absent prior holding to structural zero across the union of portfolio names.
Stored pre-trade random weights omit non-held names and therefore align them to structural zero for exact replay.
Independent random target weights omit non-held names and therefore align them to structural zero for exact turnover replay.
Independent random prior weights omit non-held names and therefore align them to structural zero for exact turnover replay.
Expected post-test random weights omit non-held names and therefore align them to structural zero for reconciliation.
Stored post-test random weights omit non-held names and therefore align them to structural zero for reconciliation.
